name: EX-1-8
description: EX-1-8 was an Imperial Navy TIE/sa bomber that was manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems. As a TIE/sa bomber, EX-1-8 carried a destructive payload consisting of proton torpedoes, guided concussion missiles, space mines, and free-falling thermal detonators. Around 3 ABY, EX-1-8 flew through the Hoth asteroid field.
